review_candidates.description: Description de l'entreprise IOTA GROUP est un groupe international spécialisé dans l'assistance technique et le recrutement de talents pour les grands projets industriels, notamment dans les secteurs du nucléaire, de l'énergie, de l'Oil & Gas et des infrastructures. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réalisation de projets complexes en mobilisant des ingénieurs et experts techniques expérimentés. Description du poste Participez à l'un des plus grands programmes industriels et nucléaires des prochaines décennies ! Dans le cadre du programme Aval du Futur (ADF), situé à La Hague, en Normandie , IOTA GROUP recrute plusieurs ingénieurs et experts techniques pour accompagner la réalisation de nouvelles installations nucléaires. Ce programme d'envergure exceptionnelle, représentant plusieurs dizaines de milliards d'euros d'investissement , prévoit la construction de nombreuses infrastructures industrielles sur plusieurs décennies. Il offre une occasion unique de participer à un projet stratégique, de relever des défis techniques majeurs et de contribuer à la réalisation d'installations industrielles de nouvelle génération. Les expertises recherchées Pour accompagner les différentes phases du programme, nous recrutons actuellement dans trois grands domaines : Génie Civil & Ingénierie Ingénieurs Génie Civil, Ingénieurs Structures, Ingénieurs Études Techniques et Ingénieurs Méthodes. Maîtrise d'Œuvre & Construction Ingénieurs et Responsables Maîtrise d'Œuvre (MOE), Ingénieurs Travaux, Conducteurs de Travaux, Responsables Construction et Superviseurs Travaux. Pilotage & Coordination de Projets Chefs de Projet Techniques, Ingénieurs Planning / OPC, Coordinateurs Techniques et Ingénieurs Qualité Construction. Vos missions Selon votre spécialité et les besoins du programme, vous serez amené(e) à : Participer aux études, à la préparation et au suivi des travaux. Coordonner les équipes techniques, les entreprises et les différents intervenants du projet. Superviser les activités de génie civil et de construction industrielle. Veiller au respect des exigences techniques, de qualité, de sécurité, de coûts et de délais. Assurer le suivi de l'avancement des travaux et la gestion des interfaces techniques. Contribuer à la réussite d'un programme industriel majeur. Qualifications Nous recherchons des professionnels disposant des compétences suivantes : Formation supérieure en génie civil, construction, travaux publics, ingénierie ou discipline équivalente. Expérience confirmée sur de grands projets industriels ou d'infrastructures complexes. Compétences en études, maîtrise d'œuvre, coordination technique ou supervision de travaux, selon la spécialité. Bonne connaissance des exigences techniques, qualité et sécurité applicables aux grands projets industriels. Capacité à travailler dans un environnement multidisciplinaire et à coordonner différents intervenants. Maîtrise du français indispensable. Une expérience dans le secteur nucléaire constitue un atout important , mais les profils issus de l'Oil & Gas, de la pétrochimie, de l'énergie ou de grands projets d'infrastructures sont également encouragés à postuler. Un projet d'envergure exceptionnelle : participez à l'un des plus importants programmes industriels et nucléaires français. Des défis techniques stimulants : contribuez à la conception et à la construction d'infrastructures complexes de nouvelle génération. Des perspectives à long terme : intégrez un programme qui se développera sur plusieurs décennies. Un environnement multidisciplinaire : collaborez avec des experts issus de différentes spécialités techniques. Un accompagnement professionnel : bénéficiez de l'expertise et du réseau international d'IOTA GROUP. Rejoignez un programme qui façonnera l'avenir de l'industrie nucléaire ! Vous êtes ingénieur génie civil, maître d'œuvre, ingénieur travaux ou expert de la construction industrielle ? Nous avons plusieurs opportunités actuellement ouvertes et recherchons des professionnels souhaitant mettre leur expertise au service d'un programme industriel d'envergure. Que vous soyez immédiatement disponible ou à l'écoute d'une nouvelle opportunité, nous serions ravis d'étudier votre candidature. Postulez dès maintenant et prenez part au programme Aval du Futur (ADF) avec IOTA GROUP !

review_candidates.title: Impact Producer
review_candidates.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About The Role The ElevenLabs Impact Program exists to democratize access to our technology and make AI work for all people, supporting for-good use cases across healthcare, education, and culture. Today, our work includes providing free and discounted access to nonprofits, partnering with university professors to bring voice AI into the classroom and the research lab, and working to restore the voices of one million people living with permanent voice loss through our 1 Million Voices initiative (learn more at elevenlabs.io/impact). We're looking for a Producer to own the external storytelling and event presence for Impact, a role that coordinates PR, agency management, social launches, documentary-style case studies, and event production. This is a hands-on, in-house role: you're the person who makes sure every launch, film, and activation meets (or, ideally raises) the bar of the rest of the company's output, working closely with our internal Design, Comms, and Events teams, and, when applicable, with the external agencies and production teams supporting PR, film, and creative execution. Much of Impact’s work is made with people who live with a disability, or are members of vulnerable communities. You will ensure their views carry equal weight and their input helps shape every project, from first conversation to final cut. As Impact's first dedicated producer, you'll build the production and launch engine for a team whose external footprint is scaling fast; this quarter alone includes more than five events, six documentaries in production, two live ElevenLabs Summit sessions, a partner launch every month, and several more case studies in flight. What You'll Do Coordinate production of Impact's documentary case studies: travel and work onsite for filming when needed, work closely with external production and direction teams, bringing opinions on story and craft, and partner with our Design team to make sure every film meets ElevenLabs' bar and brand guidelines. Work alongside subjects of our case studies, many of whom live with a disability, as equals and ensure that the production team does the same. You will build in consent, access needs, and editorial input at every stage to ensure alignment in how the story is told, cut, and shared. Plan and execute Impact's conferences and activations alongside the Events team, turning each one into an in-person moment that drives real ROI and leaves a lasting impression, with Impact's own storytelling angle built in. Support Comms in telling Impact's story through PR, coordinating with Comms and, when applicable, a PR agency to keep press windows and partner announcements on track, and helping make sure Impact's international stories get told well as the program expands globally. Partner with Design to keep all video and static collateral on-brand, advocating for a high creative standard and Impact’s lens. Carry a consistent visual and narrative thread across launches, blog content, and ElevenLabs Summit presentations. Draft copy for social and blog content, collaborating with Comms to land a final draft, and with Design on all launch-related visual assets. Manage multiple concurrent launches, shoots, and events at once. Requirements A great project manager with a sharp creative eye, someone who runs cross-functional logistics flawlessly, has real taste, and will push the team to hit it. Proven practical experience working with vulnerable communities, especially people living with a disability, and ensuring they are provided the time, space and accommodation to be equal partners in high-pressure productions, on tight timelines, and in public. Organized and detail-oriented, with a track record of juggling several production timelines at once. Creative or production background (agency, marketing, in-house brand/content team, documentary or branded content) comfortable being on set and in the room with Design, not just commissioning the work. Strong writing and visual taste; can tell when something is on-brand and polish-worthy. 2-5 years of experience in production, events, or brand marketing. Comfortable traveling for shoots and events. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

review_candidates.title: Head of Project Execution, C&I Energy
review_candidates.description: About The Role We are looking for an experienced Head of Project Execution to lead project execution for Yellow Door Energy's commercial and industrial (C&I) portfolio across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman and Qatar. The role will ideally based in Saudi Arabia but we may consider Dubai. Reporting to the Group COO, you will lead engineering and project management for our core C&I project portfolio across solar PV, BESS and grid-connected energy solutions. Your accountability will run from pre-construction design through construction and commissioning to handover to Operations & Maintenance. You will make sure projects are technically robust, safely delivered, commercially disciplined and aligned with approved investment assumptions. This is a senior leadership role that operates at both strategic and technical level. It suits someone who combines proven C&I execution leadership with deep technical knowledge of solar PV, BESS, electrical infrastructure and grid connection. You will build and lead a high-performing regional team and set the standards, governance and ways of working that shape how YDE engineers and delivers its projects. What You'll Deliver & Own Team and execution leadership Lead and develop the regional Execution team across engineering and project management, setting clear priorities, standards and accountabilities aligned with Group and country objectives. Build team capability through coaching, performance management, succession planning and recruitment as the portfolio grows. Lead senior engagement with clients, EPC contractors, consultants, suppliers and delivery partners, resolving material technical and execution issues. Work closely with Development, Commercial, Technical, Procurement and PMO, Finance, Legal, O&M and QHSSE to ensure execution requirements are reflected in project decisions and commitments. Embed consistent project governance, reporting, lessons learned and continuous improvement across the regional portfolio. Engineering, grid and pre-construction assurance Provide technical leadership across pre-construction and detailed engineering, including design reviews, constructability, site suitability and optimisation. Lead or oversee technical negotiations with clients and EPC contractors, ensuring technical requirements are properly reflected in tender packages, EPC agreements and technical appendices. Support commercial negotiations where needed. Oversee grid connection and Grid Code compliance across LV, MV and HV systems, including SEC, SERA and SASO requirements and other applicable standards. Guide major equipment specification and selection, covering PV modules, inverters, BESS, transformers, switchgear, protection, cables, tracking systems and monitoring solutions. Ensure energy yield and performance assessments, including P50/P90 analysis and uncertainty evaluation, are robust and correctly reflected in project assumptions. Project delivery, construction and handover Oversee delivery against investment committee-approved scope, budget, schedule and technical assumptions, intervening early where risk or variance emerges. Direct contractor and supplier performance, including technical coordination, design implementation, site progress, issue resolution and change management. Ensure effective QA/QC across factory acceptance testing, site inspections, mechanical completion, commissioning, PAC, FAC and end-of-warranty activities. Ensure as-built documentation, testing records, punch-list closure and handover requirements are complete for transition to O&M. Promote strong QHSSE performance and visible safety leadership across all execution activities. What You Must Bring A bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. 10+ years' relevant experience in solar PV, renewable energy or power infrastructure, including at least 5 years in a senior management or leadership role within technical consulting, EPC, project execution, engineering or asset management. A track record of leading multidisciplinary engineering and project delivery teams across development, construction, commissioning and handover. Substantial experience in EPC contracting and negotiation, contractor management, technical due diligence and delivery governance for complex energy projects. Deep technical understanding of solar PV, BESS, grid connection and LV/MV/HV electrical infrastructure, including protection and major equipment selection. Sound knowledge of GCC grid and regulatory requirements, including experience working with local utilities and applicable Grid Codes. Commercial and contractual judgement to resolve complex technical, contractual and delivery issues. Experience working effectively in a multinational, matrix environment with multiple internal and external stakeholders. Strong Advantage Registration with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE). Hands-on familiarity with PVsyst and related design or simulation tools such as SolarGIS, AutoCAD, SketchUp, PVcase or HOMER. Experience across C&I, hybrid and/or utility-scale renewable energy projects. Exposure to M&A, project acquisition or technical due diligence. You'll Thrive Here If... You are equally comfortable in leadership discussions and in a detailed design or grid review. You can challenge designs, assumptions and delivery approaches while keeping relationships constructive. You build teams with clear expectations and accountability, and you invest in developing people. You spot execution risks early and resolve them with sound technical and commercial judgement. You look for ways to raise standards, strengthen governance and turn lessons learned into better delivery across a growing portfolio. Why Join Us? You will lead the execution of C&I renewable energy projects across four markets, working across solar PV, BESS and increasingly complex grid-connected energy solutions. The role offers real influence over how YDE's projects are engineered and delivered. You will build the regional team, set delivery standards and work closely with YDE's regional leadership and Development, Commercial, Technical, Finance, Legal and Operations teams. About Yellow Door Energy Yellow Door Energy is the leading sustainable energy partner for commercial and industrial businesses across the Middle East and Africa. We deliver sustainable energy solutions through power purchase agreements and solar leases, helping businesses reduce energy costs, improve power reliability and lower carbon emissions. Our solutions include solar PV, battery energy storage systems, hybrid energy and energy efficiency. Our shareholders include Actis, Mitsui & Co, TAEF and the International Finance Corporation. Apply Now! If you are an experienced renewable energy execution leader with deep technical knowledge of solar PV, BESS and grid-connected systems, and a track record of building teams that deliver safe, high-quality projects, we'd love to hear from you. review_candidates.title: Head of Growth Social Ads
review_candidates.description: Jouw verantwoordelijkheid Je krijgt de opdracht om naast onze bestaande search groeimotor een volledig nieuwe Social Advertising divisie op te bouwen. Van strategie en eerste campagnes tot creative productie, AI, influencer content, teamopbouw en uiteindelijk winstgevende schaal. Je werkt rechtstreeks met de CEO en krijgt veel vrijheid om te bepalen wat nodig is om van social een tweede groot marketingkanaal voor GTE Brands te maken. Wat krijg je? Je ontvangt €6.000–€10.000 bruto per maand, exclusief 8% vakantiegeld, plus een performance bonus op vooraf afgesproken resultaten. Bij sterke prestaties en een goede samenwerking bestaat daarnaast de mogelijkheid om op relatief korte termijn aandelen in GTE Brands te krijgen , op nader overeen te komen voorwaarden. GTE Brands in het kort GTE Brands is een internationale e-commerce organisatie met meer dan €100 miljoen omzet. Het eerste doel is doorgroeien richting €200 miljoen, maar onze ambitie gaat verder. op de lange termijn willen we een organisatie bouwen die de strijd kan aangaan met grote internationale e-commerce partijen als bol.com, Amazon en Alibaba. Heb jij eerder een DTC growth kanaal of marketingorganisatie opgebouwd, minimaal tien marketing professionals aangestuurd en aantoonbaar social advertising winstgevend opgeschaald? Lees dan verder. Jouw werkgever: van sterke search-machine naar een tweede omzetkanaal GTE Brands heeft haar huidige schaal voor een groot deel opgebouwd via search advertising. Daardoor weten we wat het betekent om een e-commerce webshop op te schalen en succesvol te maken met performance marketing. De volgende stap is om naast die bestaande infrastructuur een tweede omzet kanaal te bouwen. Social advertising geeft ons de mogelijkheid om niet alleen bestaande vraag op te vangen, maar ook zelf vraag te creëren en merken op een andere manier te laten groeien. Tot nu toe lag veel growth verantwoordelijkheid rechtstreeks bij de CEO. Door de verdere groei van GTE Brands en nieuwe projecten zoeken we nu iemand die dit nieuwe kanaal volledig naar zich toe trekt en uitbouwt tot een zelfstandig en schaalbaar onderdeel van de organisatie. Jouw baan: Head of Growth Als Head of Growth begin je niet met het beheren van een bestaande social afdeling. Je bouwt haar zelf. Je start met onderzoek naar waar de grootste kansen liggen en bepaalt welke social kanalen nodig zijn om winstgevend te kunnen schalen. Meta en TikTok zijn logische uitgangspunten, maar je krijgt de vrijheid om andere kanalen te onderzoeken wanneer daar kansen liggen. Vanuit daar bouw je een schaalbaar performance en creative proces. Je ontwikkelt samen met je team een werkwijze waarin research wordt vertaald naar klantinzichten, hooks, scripts en advertentieconcepten. Deze creatives worden vervolgens snel geproduceerd, getest, geanalyseerd en verder opgeschaald. Daar hoort ook het bouwen van jouw eigen team bij. Je krijgt de kans om te bepalen welke expertise nodig is en vindt samen met recruitment de juiste professionals. Dit zullen verschillende disciplines zijn, maar jij zorgt ervoor dat zij samenwerken als een team met duidelijke verantwoordelijkheden, KPI's en feedback loops.
